analysisPolicy: Runtime edge count includes distinct parallel records. Degree, cross-layer counts and density use distinct endpoint pairs. Connected degree uses an explicit undirected projection; in/out degree uses recorded direction. All metrics exclude source weights.

metricDefinitions.edgeCount: Directed MultiDiGraph records, including the two conflicting safety weights.
metricDefinitions.associationCount: Simple directed graph: distinct ordered endpoint pairs; parallel records collapsed.
metricDefinitions.componentCount: Connected components of the simple undirected projection (weak components of the directed graph).
metricDefinitions.crossLayerEdges: Simple undirected projection: distinct endpoint pairs in different layers.
metricDefinitions.intralayerEdges: Simple undirected projection: distinct endpoint pairs in the same layer.
metricDefinitions.isolatedNodeCount: Simple undirected projection: nodes with no incident edges.
metricDefinitions.density: Simple undirected projection: m / (n * (n - 1) / 2), ignoring weights and parallel records.
metricDefinitions.directedDensity: Simple directed graph: m / (n * (n - 1)), ignoring weights and parallel records.
metricDefinitions.degreeRanking: Simple undirected projection: number of distinct adjacent entities, regardless of orientation.
metricDefinitions.layerCounts: Each layer's induced simple undirected subgraph; directedDensity uses its simple directed counterpart.
metricDefinitions.relationCounts: Simple directed graph: display pairs grouped by their endpoint-layer relation.
metricDefinitions.node.inDegree: Distinct predecessors in the simple directed graph.
metricDefinitions.node.outDegree: Distinct successors in the simple directed graph.
metricDefinitions.node.degree: Distinct neighbours in the simple undirected projection.
metricDefinitions.node.crossLayerDegree: Distinct neighbours in other layers in the simple undirected projection.
